admissions.compiler_qualified: Entire independently reconstructed source-built P/Stock4 plus the independently reconstructed P/C3b. Both copies of P, source-bound rustdoc, original Cargo, LLVM and Wild must agree. The stock C++ must be source-matched with actual -fno-exceptions and -DRUSTC_LLVM_NO_EXCEPTIONS.
admissions.migration: Separately owned, unscored physical test of native OSP3→4 and OSP4→3 representations. Transplant exactly one authentic checked prior record bound to the same real prior ELF into a private independently populated destination index. Verify the prefix, conventional marker, all other entries, full previous object and length-framed BLAKE3 before exposing code to rustc. Prove the former hit goes through ordinary LLVM, the other 14 previously authenticated hits still use real renames, all 125 native outputs/reader (including changed diagnostic) agree with own independently clean. Any new disagreement stops the two measured boots.
admissions.migration_kernel_open: A successful open by the actual owner rustc or one of its threads, of the challenged index or its kernel-confirmed hardlink, is required in each direction.
admissions.native: Two fresh Ruff P/Stock4 correctness histories. All 125 old, edited and clean option native objects/executables match their independently empty build; first/reverse accepted rosters match the original C3b for the corresponding same historical sources. Strict negative documented-argument and E0308; the held out 151→152 test witnesses a genuine real native link and contrary test. All ordinary invalid, fixed and clean verdicts become prerequisites.
admissions.separation: Both native slots, the migration, and the two scored workers use independently booted machines and fresh named targets. No cutoff or scheme selection from a scored value; report any failure as originally registered.

counter: Entire ordinary rustup/Cargo process plus every descendant and thread, hardware retired user instructions, inherited from exec; outer strace observes real exec only on warm scored calls, no rename or open instrumentation in counters. Keep calibrated child/fork/thread/negative tests, time_enabled==time_running>0 and raw counter. No guest/unit conversion.

primary: Every whole-Cargo user-mode instruction count for independently empty OLD, historical edit and first unchanged under both original workloads. Compare the new writer to both real C3b and P within each boot.

Report all 36 absolute raw counts, signed paired changes and multiplicative ratios individually, plus cold, unchanged, RSS, physical allocated target/build/incremental/optional bytes and true native roster. Preserve every entry, logical length, st_blocks*512, nlink, dev/ino, mode, and symlink target, de-duplicate (dev,ino) across both. Account optional bytes inside every work-products.bin separately, no second cache. Retention in evidence downloads is reported separately.

option.oracle: Whole separately linked option/schema reader, expected old/new validation and clean bytes; rlib is retained as generated, not cross-arm normalized.
